theory_variant: Agda without-K homotopy type theory (agda-unimath library, no cubical features)

agda_unimath_library.name: agda-unimath
agda_unimath_library.fetch_policy: codeload does not support Range/resume for this object (Range probe answered 200, not 206), so the tarball was fetched single-connection with the probed ETag as an If-Match precondition (no 412 was returned).
agda_unimath_library.integrity_note: GitHub publishes no SHA-256 digest for codeload commit tarballs. Identity rests on: commit SHA in the URL, the ETag pinned via If-Match, the locally computed tarball SHA-256, and gzip/tar structural checks. The local hash proves local byte identity only and is not an independent publisher attestation.
agda_unimath_library.agda_compatibility_note: The library's own flake.nix at this commit states that the pinned nixpkgs carries Agda 2.8.0; the replay uses the project's pinned Agda 2.8.0-3d04bac binary.

source_policy: The user-authored derived source stays in the project; the external agda-unimath checkout stays on the D: toolchain cache and is pinned by commit SHA, tarball hash, library-file hash and deterministic source-tree hash. Regenerable *.agdai interfaces and .DS_Store are excluded from the tree identity.
secret_policy: No credentials, cookies, signed redirect URLs or full environment dumps are retained.
